description: This file contains utility functions for audio processing within the Pipecat project. It includes functions for audio mixing, normalization, resampling, format conversion between PCM, μ-law, and A-law, silence detection, and loudness measurement. It also provides factory functions for creating different types of audio resamplers.

methods.name: BaseAudioResampler create_default_resampler(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a deprecated default audio resampler instance, advises to use specific factory functions instead.

methods.name: BaseAudioResampler create_file_resampler(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates an audio resampler instance for batch processing of audio files.

methods.name: BaseAudioResampler create_stream_resampler(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a stream audio resampler instance for real-time processing.

methods.name: bytes mix_audio(audio1: bytes, audio2: bytes)
methods.description: Mixes two PCM audio streams by adding their samples, with clipping to 16-bit range.

methods.name: bytes interleave_stereo_audio(left_audio: bytes, right_audio: bytes)
methods.description: Combines two mono PCM audio streams into a stereo stream by interleaving samples.

methods.name: normalize_value(value, min_value, max_value)
methods.description: Normalizes a value to [0,1] based on specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: float calculate_audio_volume(audio: bytes, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Calculates the loudness of audio data using EBU R128 standard and normalizes to [0,1].

methods.name: float exp_smoothing(value: float, prev_value: float, factor: float)
methods.description: Applies exponential smoothing to a time-series value.

methods.name: ulaw_to_pcm( ulaw_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler )
methods.description: Converts μ-law encoded audio to PCM and resamples if needed.

methods.name: pcm_to_ulaw(pcm_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler)
methods.description: Converts PCM audio to μ-law encoding and resamples if needed.

methods.name: bytes alaw_to_pcm( alaw_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler )
methods.description: Converts A-law encoded audio to PCM and resamples if needed.

methods.name: pcm_to_alaw(pcm_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler)
methods.description: Converts PCM audio to A-law encoding and resamples if needed.

methods.name: bool is_silence(pcm_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Determines if a PCM audio sample contains silence based on amplitude threshold.
